analogy.rationale: Antimalarials like artemisinins and quinolines act on parasite-specific targets (e.g., PfATP6/ATP1A1) and MRGPRX1, a sensory GPCR minimally expressed in these cell lines, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other anti-infective/antiprotozoal classes, with ATPase and GPCR classes sharing nominal target overlap.
